I_ACCESS.description: Users are experiencing issues like being unable to log into their account or password rejection.

I_BILLING.description: Complaints include feeling that the app has become overly monetized with premium requirements or excessive ads.

I_CATALOG.description: Users report missing songs in the catalog or inconsistent availability of lyrics for tracks.
